title: SocialScience InterviewThematicAnalysis

stats.done_summary: The research task is complete. Quantitative analysis revealed that both the transit_primary and car_primary cohorts provided similarly detailed feedback, with mean response lengths of approximately 20 words. The LLM-assisted thematic analysis identified distinct priorities: transit users focus on real-time accuracy, physical safety (crowding, night travel), and accessibility, while car users prioritize multimodal integration, cost transparency (parking and fuel), and interface simplicity. Both groups share a fundamental need for trust through accurate information and clear cost visibility. All deliverables, including the code, intermediate outputs, figures, and the final report (report.md and interview_thematic_report.md), have been successfully generated and saved in their respective directories.
